transcript.text: Terafform versus Ansible. What is the
difference? Hashikorp Terapform is an
infrastructure as code tool used to
create cloud infrastructures like
servers, databases, network, storage,
etc. Once the infrastructure is created,
you can configure them using
configuration management tool like
anible. So, Ansible is a configuration
management tool that can be used to
install software, start, stop services,
manage configuration files and lot more.
In short, Teraphform is used to create
infrastructure. Anible is used to
configure it. For example, a DevOps
engineer will use Terapform to create
EC2 instance in the cloud and then use
Ansible to install and configure EngineX
server on that EC2 instance created by
Terapform.
